business: Mascott (working name): customisable cute animated AI mascot agents that chat with visitors and act on a website or SaaS
by_segment: Small SaaS startup team (2-20 people), founder or PM
Small business / showcase site owner (Wix, WordPress, Webflow)
Web agency or freelancer building sites for clients
by_behaviour: Already pays for a chatbot and is OK with it
why_not: I already pay for a chatbot and it's fine, so I have no reason to redo the setup. The part that would actually be new is the AI filling forms and starting checkout on my site, and that's the part I don't trust in front of my customers.

I would try the free plan at most, and 50 conversations with a badge is enough to test it. I would not pay inside a month without reviews on G2 or Capterra and proof that visitors use it instead of ignoring it.

I'd sign up for the free plan and poke at it because I try every new AI tool, but I already have a chatbot and I only keep about one in ten. A cute mascot doesn't solve a problem I'd pay for within a month.
I build client sites in Webflow and Framer, and a chat widget wired to an LLM API is a weekend job for me. I'd rather own the code than rent a mascot per month.

I'd sign up for the free plan, maybe, but 50 conversations a month is nothing and I'd rather live with the badge than pay. My site is a showcase site, a chat mascot is a nice-to-have, not something I'd pay 29 a month for.
I'd probably poke at the free plan because I try everything, but a cartoon mascot on my brand looks childish to me, and I keep maybe one tool in ten. I wouldn't pay within a month.
flip: Proof, with real numbers from a similar SaaS, that the mascot lifts onboarding or trial conversion over a plain chat widget, plus on-site actions that work on my app without custom engineering during the trial.

Proof that the on-site actions are safe, meaning a hard allow-list of actions, a confirm step before anything that spends money or books something, and a full log I can review. It would also have to work alongside my current chat inbox so I don't have to migrate anything.

Independent G2/Capterra reviews plus a case study showing a measurable lift in activation or conversion, and a clear answer on child data safety, with the free plan hitting its limit because it is actually being used.
A free plan with several hundred conversations and no badge, or a one-time price under 10 EUR, with clear proof it lifts leads on a site like mine.
A white-label or agency plan with a flat price across many client sites, unlimited conversations, and the mascot and animation set exportable so I can resell it as my own add-on.
A real A/B test from a site like mine showing a clear lift in sign-ups or sales, plus on-site actions that work without me building them.

A published A/B test or case study from a comparable SaaS showing a measurable lift in trial signups or activation, plus proof the script adds negligible load time (Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals numbers).
A/B test data from a real site like mine showing the mascot raises conversions or bookings, plus a way to make the character look polished and non-childish.
A serious, non-cartoon avatar style that fits a professional brand, plus a one-click import of my current chatbot's content and proof it converts better than what I have.
A controlled A/B test or case study from a similar small SaaS showing a measurable lift in signups or conversion, plus hard guardrails that stop the agent from taking any action I haven't approved.
A clear GDPR/DPA page with EU data hosting, plus a hard cap or predictable overage pricing, and a trial where it answers my own docs accurately.
Hard data from comparable small sites that the mascot raises conversions, plus on-site actions on the Starter plan at around 15 EUR.
A white-label option I can resell to clients, with a hard guarantee or permission controls on what actions it can take, plus an easy import from Intercom/Crisp/Tidio.
A/B test data from real sites showing a measurable lift in conversion or bookings, plus hard guardrails and a log of every action it takes so it can't do anything off-script in front of customers.
A live demo on a site like mine showing visitors engaging with it, real conversion numbers from a comparable SaaS, and enough design control to make the mascot clearly mine and not a template.
A clear GDPR/DPA page with EU data hosting, a hard cap or predictable overage pricing, and a G2/Capterra listing with real reviews showing it beats my current tool on conversion.

Published accuracy numbers on content like mine, a way to restrict answers to my docs with a hard refuse-when-unsure mode, full conversation logs and approval controls for on-site actions, plus a few G2 reviews from SaaS teams like mine.
Seeing a live Shopify store using it with a real page-speed score, plus proof it measurably lifted sales or cut support tickets. I'd also need to hit the 50-conversation limit on the free plan first.
Proof of guardrails (confirm-before-action, a log of every action, an off switch) plus real G2 or Capterra reviews from sites like mine.
A mascot layer that sits on top of my existing Intercom/Crisp/Tidio bot with no migration, or a one-time or very cheap price for the character alone.
